description: Incoming data batches generated for data-drift monitoring testing. Each batch is derived from the original training data (X_train) with controlled distribution shifts. The XGBoost model (V4) and threshold (V5=0.29) are frozen.

batches.description: Random sample with replacement from baseline. No intentional distribution shift applied. Control case.

transformations.rationale: New customer acquisition wave bringing shorter-tenure customers

transformations.method: Add $5 offset, clip to original domain range
transformations.rationale: Modest price adjustment and upselling of premium services

transformations.rationale: Maintains internal consistency — TotalCharges depends on tenure and MonthlyCharges

batches.description: Mild distribution shift: Contract skewed toward Month-to-month (~65%), tenure shifted lower (~26 mo mean), MonthlyCharges increased by $5, TotalCharges recalculated for consistency. Represents a plausible competitive pressure + new customer acquisition scenario.

transformations.rationale: Aggressive market shift toward flexible, no-commitment plans

transformations.target: Adjusted to maintain consistency with shifted tenure and charges

batches.description: Strong distribution shift: Contract heavily skewed toward Month-to-month (~75%), tenure shifted very low (~18 mo mean), MonthlyCharges increased by $12, InternetService shifted toward Fiber optic (~60%), TotalCharges recalculated for consistency.
